title: DextER: Language-driven Dexterous Grasp Generation with Embodied Reasoning
authors: Junha Lee, Eunha Park, Minsu Cho

tldr.zh: DextER 根据物体点云和语言指令，在同一自回归模型中先预测“哪些手指连杆接触物体哪里”，再以接触序列为条件生成手腕位姿与手指关节角，并支持通过指定部分接触点控制抓姿。
tldr.en: Given an object point cloud and a language instruction, DextER first predicts which finger links contact where on the object, then conditions wrist-pose and finger-joint generation on this contact sequence within one autoregressive model; users can steer grasps by specifying partial contacts.

evaluation_scope.zh: PartField 点云编码器经 MLP 接入 Qwen2.5-0.5B；接触 token 编码连杆身份及三维位置，作为后续抓姿 token 的前缀条件，输出 Shadow Hand 抓取构型。利用 MuJoCo 为 DexGYS／Dexonomy 抓姿提取接触标签，采用 next-token 监督微调全部组件，无 RL；接触位置 dropout 保留连杆身份、随机移除坐标。两数据集分别训练模型，Dexonomy 检验未见物体／抓握类型。DexGYS 仿真成功率为 67.14%，去除接触推理为 62.37%；该成功率采用至少一个重力方向稳定的基准条件，不能当作真机成功率。部分接触前缀引导不需更新模型权重；预测接触并非触觉反馈，输出不含完整闭环操作轨迹，未报告真机验证。官方已发布训练／评测代码、预处理数据，并列出 DexGYS／Dexonomy 两套 checkpoint 下载入口，尚未在本仓库复现。
evaluation_scope.en: An MLP connects PartField point-cloud features to Qwen2.5-0.5B. Contact tokens encode link identities and 3D positions, prefixing grasp tokens that specify a Shadow Hand configuration. MuJoCo supplies contact labels for DexGYS/Dexonomy; all components are finetuned by supervised next-token prediction without RL. Contact-position dropout removes coordinates while retaining link identities. Separate models are trained on the two datasets; Dexonomy tests unseen objects/grasp types. DexGYS simulation success is 67.14%, versus 62.37% without contact reasoning, using a benchmark criterion requiring stability under at least one gravity direction, not hardware success. Partial-contact prefixes steer generation without weight updates. Predicted contacts are not tactile feedback; outputs are not full closed-loop manipulation trajectories, and no hardware validation is reported. Official resources release training/evaluation code and preprocessed data, and list separate DexGYS/Dexonomy checkpoint downloads; not reproduced in this repository.
